comparison.objective: Candidate separates ceramic finishing media from washers; record spikes an IV bag and primes its drip chamber.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests bimanual screen grasping, pouring and agitation; record tests aseptic cap removal, precise spike insertion and controlled chamber squeeze/release.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate grades recovery yield, part retention and spill-free support dwell; record requires uncontaminated interfaces, 23–25 mm spike seating, specified liquid height and safe release.
comparison.reason: Aseptic insertion and fluid priming are meaningfully different from rigid granular separation.
